lines.speaker: SCIENTIST
lines.text: Do we have them in storage?

lines.speaker: SCIENTIST
lines.text: Then where can I find them?

lines.speaker: TERMINAL LOG
lines.text: An abandoned botanical facility has been identified as a potential source.

lines.speaker: SCIENTIST
lines.text: No one has been outside in decades!

lines.speaker: TERMINAL LOG
lines.text: Correction. No human presence has been recorded in the external environment for 47 years.

lines.speaker: TERMINAL LOG
lines.text: Environmental conditions are unsuitable for unprotected human exposure.

lines.speaker: TERMINAL LOG
lines.text: Protective equipment and an oxygen supply are required.

lines.speaker: SCIENTIST
lines.text: So I need to search for a protective suit and an oxygen bottle...
